Changes: rewritten in plain wiki text for the Ambox here; left out the "Find sources" search links and the "Learn how and when to remove this message" link, which are for Wikipedia; links to Wikipedia's help pages left out; no find, small or category options; bold with BBCode; removed the source's documentation and categories.
Example: {{More citations needed}}
Expect: This article needs more citations. Please help improve this article by adding citations to reliable sources. Unsourced material may be challenged and removed.
Example: {{More citations needed|section}}
Expect: This section needs more citations. Please help improve this section by adding citations to reliable sources. Unsourced material may be challenged and removed.
